implementation.summary: StagedAnnotation, FrozenFrame, MirrorStage.Frozen and six MirrorIntent cases. selectedIndex is the 1-based StagedAnnotation.index so all three index-bearing intents speak one unit. Annotations go INTO Orbit state (small, value-equal, user-paced); the bitmap does not.

troubleshooting.issue: T-3 TAC-4 asked that all six intents compile with NO handler wired - not achievable: handleIntent's when(intent) is also exhaustive with no else, so it fails with 'when expression must be exhaustive'.
troubleshooting.resolution: T-4 was in the same batch so handlers landed immediately; a lone T-3 would have needed six placeholder branches. Reported rather than quietly satisfied.
